_notes.forbid_same_crop_consecutive: Prevents monoculture sequences (same crop in back-to-back slots). FAO crop rotation best practice.
_notes.same_family_penalty: Penalty (0-1) applied per adjacent pair in the same botanical family (e.g., two Poaceae in a row). Discourages all-cereal rotations with high disease build-up risk.
_notes.carryover_strength: Multiplier (0-1) on crop.soil_effect for soil fertility carry-over between slots. 0.5 = moderate; 1.0 = full carry-over. Represents how much of the previous crop's soil benefit transfers.
_notes.source: FAO Crop Rotation Guidelines; BARC Bangladesh Cropping Patterns; general agronomy principles.
